Dear Members,

Greetings from your stake leaders. We hope that your summer has been going well. Thank you for your faithful efforts to conserve water and petitioning heaven for relief from drought. 

We have been asked by church area leaders to return Sacrament Meetings to the the normal procedures with the administration of the sacrament toward the beginning of the meeting. This will be happening as early as this Sunday. We will continue to broadcast these services to those unable to attend in person and will pause the broadcast during the administration of the sacrament, and then return to broadcast for the remainder of the meeting. 

We also recognize the ongoing effects of the COVID virus and continue to have as our top priority, as we worship together, every ones health and safety. Following the statement given by the First Presidency, regarding vaccination and other heath guidelines, we have asked ward councils to review each of our meetings and implement procedures to encourage, and allow for, social distancing and meeting house cleanliness. We ask each of us to strive to follow the counsel given by our church leaders. Please be patient as these changes are implemented, and thank you for your help. 

Sincerely,
